errors.evidence: The description states there are five discrete points on the x-axis but then lists six points (mBERT-0, mBERT-10, mBERT-30, mBERT-50, mBERT-80, mBERT-100), which is the correct number shown in the chart.
The visible y-axis labels in the chart range from 82% to 90%, not 81% to 91%.
The y-axis tick marks are labeled at intervals of 2% (82, 84, 86, 88, 90), not 1%.

errors.text_span: 在mBERT-50之后上升斜率略有增大
errors.evidence: This statement is an over-generalization and partially incorrect. While the slope for Precision and F1 Score does appear to increase, the slope for the Recall (red line) decreases between mBERT-80 and mBERT-100 compared to the previous segment.
